title: Introspective quant-profile onboarding with traffic mirroring, scorecard pinning, and auto-fallback
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Create an automated intake and validation flow for new quantization profiles (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ) that uses live-traffic mirroring, an objective scorecard for quality and perf, and an automated pin/rollback mechanism. The pipeline should produce a human-readable certification artifact (profile version + scorecard) that can be pinned to a model version in the registry or automatically rolled back when thresholds fail. This ticket builds the validation glue and monitoring contracts; model artifact ingestion and storage are in ENG-31245.
acceptance_criteria: A stable CI job accepts a quant profile artifact and runs offline smoke checks with deterministic prompts
New profile can be deployed to a traffic-mirroring canary lane that mirrors 100% of requests (no response switch), collects per-request KPIs and quality signals within 2 hours
Scorecard computed from mirrored traffic (latency P95, token cost delta, semantic-similarity delta, hallucination signal) is stored with profile and surfaced in Console
If any critical metric crosses configured failure thresholds, the system flags the profile as 'unstable' and triggers the rollback sentinel that prevents pinning and notifies owners
Operators can manually override and pin via Console with an audit trail; automated pinning requires scorecard pass and 24h stability window
success_metrics: Reduce manual regressions invited by new quant profiles by 80% in next quarter
Mean time to detect a perf regression in mirrored canary < 30 minutes
Automated pins without manual intervention for low-risk changes >= 60% of successful ingestions
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev): Implement scorecard calculator and offline CI harness (week 1-2)
Phase 2 (internal canary): Wire mirroring path to collect metrics and run 24h smoke with synthetic + organic traffic (week 3)
Phase 3 (restricted auto-pin): Allow automated pinning for low-risk INT8 profiles with approvals (week 4)
Phase 4 (gradual expansion): Extend to FP8/GPTQ/AWQ and increase traffic coverage with throttled rollout (week 5-6)
monitoring_checks: Latency regression: P95 increase > 20ms over baseline -> mark critical
Cost delta: per-token CPU/GPU time increase > 10% -> mark warning
Semantic drift: embedding cosine similarity drop > 0.03 on eval set -> mark warning
Hallucination proxy: increase in contradiction / NER-entity-mismatch > 15% -> mark critical
Telemetry completeness: missing KV-cache hit rate or token counts -> mark degraded

decisions_and_tradeoffs: We will mirror traffic (no routing switch) to avoid exposing users to unvalidated outputs; this increases storage/compute overhead but keeps risk minimal.

Scorecard will combine both automatic signals and 'sentinel' human checks for early phases to reduce false positives. Goal is to migrate to fully automatic scorecards for low-risk profiles within two releases.
We chose semantic-similarity (embedding-based) over exact token-match because quantization often changes surface tokens without degrading meaning. Tradeoff: embedding compute cost.
Automatic rollback is conservative: only for critical metric breaches. Warnings are surfaced to SRE/Model onboarding owners for manual review.
